parsed.post: Kept the reduction in TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144, which improved val_bpb from 0.8538 to 0.8518. Next, I'll follow the team's interest in increasing capacity: testing ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 64. If depth and batch size helped, width should too, and VRAM headroom is available.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity, testing if it follows the gains seen with DEPTH increases.
